# Tedix

> One shared to-do list, memory and record for your team and AI agents. Agents ask before risky steps, and every step is on record. Public source; local preview without login.

- [Review Tedix for your project](https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix/blob/main/AGENT-REVIEW.md): A 15-minute coding-agent prompt, report format and feedback submission without CLI setup.
- [Documentation index](https://docs.tedix.dev/llms.txt): Select current product documentation.
- [Getting started](https://docs.tedix.dev/getting-started/): Local setup with Git, Bun and Node.js 22+.
- [Agent guide](https://docs.tedix.dev/agent-guide/): Discovery, authority and evidence boundaries.
- [Release status](https://docs.tedix.dev/release-status/): Availability and experimental hosting limits.
